sys_cb_topic.description: This Topic Block handles the replacement of an existing badge for a user. It is typically used when a badge is lost, damaged, expired, or needs to be upgraded (e.g., from a temporary to a permanent badge). Inputs: User ID: The unique identifier of the user whose badge is being replaced. Badge Type: Type of the badge to be replaced Output: Response String: A confirmation message or status string indicating the outcome of the badge replacement process.
sys_cb_topic.name: Guardian Badge Replacement Topic Block
